integrity: The source Toeplitz parameters are reconstructed exactly over \(\mathbb F_3\). Gram rank and hull dimension are obtained by exact finite-field elimination; the ambient code, hull, and both nonzero hull cosets are exhaustively enumerated. The distance-optimality of the hull follows from the ternary Griesmer bound.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the specific ternary length-\(22\) DT-optimal representative supplied by Harada and Yamaguchi. It does not classify all optimal ternary \([22,10,9]_3\) self-orthogonal codes or assert analogous hull behavior for other double Toeplitz optima.
title: A maximal proper hull inside the unique ternary length-22 non-circulant DT optimum
